europe_now.title: Ukraine launches large-scale drone attacks on Russian territory
europe_now.summary: Ukraine has launched one of its largest drone offensives against Russia, striking multiple regions including Belgorod and causing casualties. In response, Russian authorities cancelled a major military festival in Moscow and reported deadly retaliatory strikes.

sources.headline: Ukraine launches one of its largest drone attacks on Russia
Russia and Ukraine trade more deadly strikes

europe_now.title: Wildfires rage across Belgium and France prompting international assistance
europe_now.summary: Wildfires have spread across Belgium and southwestern France, prompting evacuations and international firefighting assistance. French Prime Minister Lecornu faced angry residents during a visit to affected areas while announcing substantial government aid.

sources.headline: International help arrives as wildfires rage across Belgium
Wildfires: Belgium battles blaze, France's Lecornu jeered

top_stories.title: Major data breach exposes French taxpayers' personal information
top_stories.summary: French authorities have alerted taxpayers that their personal data was compromised in a large-scale cyberattack. The breach prompts concerns about identity theft and the security of government databases.

sources.headline: French taxpayers warned after personal data stolen in major hack

top_stories.title: EU acts against nihilist online extremist network
top_stories.summary: The European Union has taken measures against an online extremist network known as 'The Com' that promotes nihilist violence. The move highlights gaps in current security policies for tackling digital radicalization.

sources.headline: EU action against ‘The Com’, a nihilist online extremist network, shows that security policies might be outdated

top_stories.title: Germany debates banning far-right party
top_stories.summary: German politicians and legal experts are split on whether to pursue a ban on the far-right Alternative for Germany party. The debate reflects deep divisions over the balance between democratic resilience and political freedom.

sources.headline: Germany divided over proposals to outlaw the far right

top_stories.title: Latvia seeks billions in EU aid for war fallout
top_stories.summary: Latvia's prime minister has asked the European Union for seven billion euros to manage economic and security pressures stemming from Russia's war in Ukraine. The request underscores the conflict's widening fiscal impact on frontline EU states.

sources.headline: Latvia wants €7B from EU to cope with fallout from Russia’s war

top_stories.title: Sicilian museum suffers massive art theft
top_stories.summary: Thieves stole artworks valued at eighty million euros from a museum in Sicily in a major cultural heist. Italian authorities have launched an investigation to recover the stolen masterpieces.

sources.headline: Sicilian museum hit by €80 million art theft
